gen-space-mono-fs-ranade: Typewriter-stiff stencil letters up top, then a loose, stretched-out line below. Ranade's gentle taper and tall lowercase soften what Space Mono draws as a rigid ribbon.
gen-space-mono-montserrat: Montserrat reads wide and gliding, with generous curves that slide past quickly. Space Mono is best at being blunt and mechanical, while Montserrat does its best work being smooth and welcoming in a plain sans way.
gen-special-elite-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro keeps its curves open and its lines crisp, like bent steel rod under a worn, smudged headline in Special Elite. Be Vietnam Pro is the steadier half, and that gap is the whole appeal.
gen-special-elite-fs-hoover: Hoover reads sturdy and refined, with short ascenders and a generous opening into the e under Special Elite's scuffed, oversized lowercase. Expect a comfortable, unhurried read.
gen-special-elite-fs-nunito: Special Elite brings a scuffed, typewritten look with a wide-mouthed a, while Nunito's big round bowls and open endings take over below. Pages of it should feel friendly and easy going.
gen-special-elite-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tight, with big counters and curves that refuse to close, a warm plain sans under the headline. And Special Elite's distressed, tall-filling lowercase stands out best when it is sized well above it.
gen-special-elite-fs-trench-slab: Worn and typewritten, Special Elite fills the line with oversized lowercase, and Trench Slab sits under it, dignified and compact. One does rough character best; the other does refined structure.
gen-special-elite-montserrat: Distressed and a bit rebellious, Special Elite fills each line with its wide-mouthed a. Montserrat is the smooth foil, with its wire-like glide, where the headline is gritty and knocked about.
gen-special-elite-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab reads precise and structured, its middle zone dominating the line with open throats on a, c, e and s. Against Special Elite's distressed look, the structure becomes the pair's best quality.
gen-syne-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Syne's x-height climbs almost to cap height, giving headlines a bold, experimental stripe of constant ink. And Be Vietnam Pro follows with open curves and a high mean line that read cleanly.
